researchMethod: Bounded primary-source web research with Exa. 104 search-result slots requested; selected original publisher pages and documents read. No live metrics are seeded, no source-feed endpoint is invented, and source-directory entries do not certify availability or operating capacity.

importantChanges.statement: OCHA ended support for HXL standard and HDX-related HXL services on 31 January 2026. HXL remains an open standard usable in internal workflows. Implement local HXL-friendly export without depending on the retired HXL proxy or Quick Charts.

standards.title: Common Alerting Protocol 1.2
standards.description: Standard alert exchange format with multilingual information blocks, geographies, updates, cancellations and expiry.

constraints: identifier and sender must not contain spaces, commas, < or &.
category may repeat; an info block requires at least one category.
Use numeric timezone offsets. Alphabetic Z is prohibited. UTC must be rendered -00:00.
Restricted scope requires restriction. Private scope requires addresses.
references encode sender,identifier,sent tuples separated by whitespace.
An area block requires areaDesc. A resource block requires resourceDesc and mimeType.
Information blocks may repeat for translations. language defaults to en-US.
The application should validate XML against CAP 1.2 and state its profile limits before claiming full producer conformance.

standards.applicationPolicy: Historical seed messages and demonstrations remain Test or Draft. Actual publication requires a human-reviewed claim and an explicitly authorized publisher. CAP alone does not grant operational authority.

standards.title: Humanitarian Exchange Language 1.1, archived reference
standards.description: Lightweight spreadsheet metadata using hashtags and plus-prefixed attributes. Official library documentation retains parsing and tagging examples.
standards.implementation: Use a human-readable header row plus a hashtag row. Prefer #country+code, #adm1+name, #sector, #date+reported and #org+name. Use explicit #x_ extension hashtags for relay-specific claim identity, layer, review state and source link instead of claiming custom fields are core HXL. Do not export private contact tags.
standards.limitation: OCHA support and HXL proxy/Quick Charts services ended 31 January 2026. HXL friendliness is local interoperability, not a current HDX requirement.

standards.title: Sphere Handbook, fourth edition
standards.description: Humanitarian Charter, protection principles and minimum standards for WASH, food security/nutrition, shelter/settlement and health.
standards.implementation: Attach specific standard references to WASH and nutrition indicators and proposed interventions. Preserve contextual guidance and local participation. Do not turn a single threshold into a clinical diagnosis or sufficient proof of programme quality.
standards.limitation: Sphere does not provide a standalone education chapter; use INEE for education. No claim of Sphere certification is made.

standards.title: Core Humanitarian Standard, 2024 edition
standards.description: Nine commitments concerning quality, accountability, dignity and the primary role of affected people in finding solutions.
standards.implementation: Expose local correction, accessible complaints, consent expectations, review reasons and learning/outcome records. Community feedback requires moderation and must not automatically create public claims.
standards.limitation: Software alignment is not organizational CHS verification or certification.

standards.title: INEE Minimum Standards for Education, 2024 edition
standards.publisher: Inter-agency Network for Education in Emergencies
standards.description: Framework for inclusive, equitable, safe education preparedness, response and recovery in crises.
standards.implementation: Reference INEE for education access, safe learning spaces, participation and education recovery. Nexus rules may flag service-disruption questions for review, but cannot certify a learning site as safe.

standards.title: Early warning alert and response in emergencies: an operational guide
standards.description: Operational guidance distinguishes signals, events, alerts, verification, risk assessment and response.
standards.implementation: Maintain a signal log and explicit verification gate. Health signals go to qualified health reviewers; generated pattern matches are candidates. EWARS complements national disease surveillance and should reconnect with it after emergencies.
standards.limitation: The relay is not WHO EWARS software or an authorized disease-surveillance system. Do not publish unverified outbreak declarations.

standards.title: IPC Technical Manual 3.1 and projection guidance
standards.description: Evidence-convergence protocols distinguish acute food insecurity, chronic food insecurity and acute malnutrition and retain classification uncertainty.
standards.implementation: Store source-published classification, analysis period, projection period and assumptions separately. A risk-of-Famine statement differs from a Famine classification. Never generate an IPC classification from a local score.
standards.limitation: IPC situation analysis is not an outcome-monitoring or intervention-impact evaluation tool. Historical projections expire and must not be displayed as current observations.

standards.title: RapidPro API v2
standards.description: HTTPS JSON API for contacts, message broadcasts and workflow starts.

implementation.authentication: Authorization: Token <secret>; server-side storage only; HTTPS required.
constraints: flow is required for flow starts.
contacts, groups and urns each accept up to 100 strings.
Flow-start params is an object with at most 10K characters; current docs use params, not legacy extra.
Set restart_participants false and exclude_active true unless a reviewer explicitly changes these behaviors.
Use ISO-639-3 keys such as eng, fra, ara in translated text objects.
Honor Retry-After on HTTP 429. Do not retry unchanged invalid requests after HTTP 400.
Starting a flow is asynchronous; an accepted request does not verify delivery or an intervention outcome.

standards.limitation: Compatibility can be tested with a local mock; actual delivery requires a configured deployment, authorized recipients and human dispatch approval.

standards.title: OCHA Data Responsibility Guidelines, January 2025
standards.description: Principles and operational procedures for safe, ethical and effective handling of humanitarian personal and non-personal data.
standards.implementation: Apply disclosure-risk review to geography, populations and linked evidence. Aggregate, redact or suppress sensitive public output before feeds, CAP, offline packs and QR generation. Country/admin-1 rules are conservative application policies, not universal guarantees of anonymity.
standards.limitation: Aggregation alone may still reveal vulnerable groups in sparse locations; private details should not enter public records.

standards.title: African Charter on the Rights and Welfare of the Child
standards.description: Regional child-rights instrument addressing best interests, privacy, education, health and protection including during armed conflict and displacement.
standards.implementation: Use as a governance reference for child-first review and protection. It does not confer authority on software or replace national legal review.

sourceDirectory.title: UNICEF Humanitarian Action for Children
sourceDirectory.description: Country appeals and dated situation reports across nutrition, health, WASH, education and protection.

sourceDirectory.title: Africa CDC surveillance and disease intelligence resources
sourceDirectory.description: Primary epidemic intelligence reports, surveillance guidance and risk assessments; reports select priority events rather than all events.

sourceDirectory.title: WHO Regional Office for Africa
sourceDirectory.description: Official regional health updates and country guidance. Verify report date and geographic coverage before using a statement.

sourceDirectory.title: WFP operations database
sourceDirectory.description: Country operation and strategic-plan documents; published plans do not prove current capacity, stock, access or funding.

sourceDirectory.title: IPC analyses and resources
sourceDirectory.description: Source-published food insecurity and malnutrition analyses with stated current and projection periods.

sourceDirectory.title: UNHCR Operational Data Portal
sourceDirectory.description: Operational displacement documents and datasets. Keep source, data date and publication date separate; coverage can differ across countries.

sourceDirectory.title: African Committee of Experts on the Rights and Welfare of the Child
sourceDirectory.description: Child-rights governance and reports; does not establish that a service is available locally.

sourceDirectory.title: UNHCR Sudan situation
sourceDirectory.description: Cross-border displacement and response documents for Sudan and neighboring countries, including Chad.

sourceDirectory.title: UNICEF Sudan situation reports
sourceDirectory.description: Dated country reports; regional and state details need report-specific attribution.

sourceDirectory.title: UNICEF Chad
sourceDirectory.description: Official Chad programme and refugee-response reporting; country website does not guarantee local response availability.

sourceDirectory.title: UNICEF South Sudan situation reports
sourceDirectory.description: Dated multisector reports, with source-specific mentions of Jonglei and flood-affected areas.

sourceDirectory.title: UNHCR South Sudan situation
sourceDirectory.description: Regional refugee data and dated population dashboards; not a Jonglei-local service roster.

sourceDirectory.title: UNICEF DRC situation reports
sourceDirectory.description: Official country and eastern-conflict reports for protection, WASH, health, nutrition and education.

sourceDirectory.title: UNICEF Somalia situation reports
sourceDirectory.description: Dated country reports; avoid treating national statistics as Bay-specific evidence.
sourceDirectory.retrievalLimitation: Directory fetch timed out twice during research. Direct UNICEF Somalia report PDFs were discoverable; the timeout does not establish that the directory is unavailable.

sourceDirectory.title: Food Security and Nutrition Analysis Unit Somalia
sourceDirectory.description: Seasonal assessments and IPC documents, including separately described Bay rural, urban and displaced populations.

seedObservations.title: Historical reference: displacement and nutrition response in eastern Chad
seedObservations.statement: In its June 2025 reporting, UNICEF described Sudanese refugee arrivals into eastern Chad and malnutrition treatment needs in Wadi Fira following attacks near El Fasher.
seedObservations.sourceTitle: UNICEF Chad: Sudanese crisis nutrition response in Wadi Fira
seedObservations.limitation: Qualitative publisher summary only. No individual stories, names or health details are copied. Does not establish current displacement, need, funding or service availability.

seedObservations.title: Historical reference: flooding and service disruption involving Jonglei
seedObservations.statement: UNICEF's August 2025 report described conflict and flooding affecting Jonglei among other states, alongside displacement and disrupted humanitarian operations.
seedObservations.sourceTitle: UNICEF South Sudan Humanitarian Situation Report No. 8
seedObservations.limitation: The source includes national and multi-state reporting. Its national totals are not Jonglei measurements. It does not establish conditions in October 2026.

seedObservations.title: Historical reference: disrupted education in Ituri and eastern DRC
seedObservations.statement: A May 2025 UNICEF release described violence and displacement interrupting education in Ituri, and reported wider conflict-related education disruption across eastern DRC including North Kivu.
seedObservations.sourceTitle: UNICEF: additional children out of school in Ituri
seedObservations.limitation: This is a dated publisher statement. Do not distribute incident coordinates, school-level vulnerability or individual protection allegations. Local conditions require refreshed evidence and human review.

seedObservations.title: Historical reference: Bay WASH and nutrition assessment context
seedObservations.statement: The September 2025 Somalia IPC snapshot described inadequate WASH access and disease burden as contributors to malnutrition, including among populations in Bay and Baidoa.
seedObservations.sourceTitle: Somalia IPC Acute Food Insecurity and Malnutrition Snapshot, July–December 2025
seedObservations.limitation: A source-reported assessment context, not a current local measurement or a generated diagnosis. Do not merge rural, urban and displaced populations into a single severity figure.

seedObservations.title: Expired source forecast: Bay urban displaced populations, October–December 2025
seedObservations.statement: The same IPC snapshot projected worsening food insecurity for urban displaced populations in Bay during October–December 2025 under its rainfall, price, conflict and assistance assumptions.
seedObservations.sourceTitle: Somalia IPC Acute Food Insecurity and Malnutrition Snapshot, July–December 2025
seedObservations.limitation: Expired forecast. It is not evidence that the forecast materialized and must not be displayed as a current alert.

implementationRecommendations: Never mark seeded reference claims reviewed solely because the source is reputable. Source provenance and local review are separate fields.
Keep source publication date, observation period, retrieval date, forecast horizon and review date separate.
Treat threshold, trend, nexus and intervention-window outputs as deterministic application inferences, with rule ID, inputs and limitations; do not present them as validated humanitarian predictions.
Cascade edges express possible mechanisms and prompt review; they do not prove causation or rank identifiable children.
Use timestamps and source URL hashes for deduplication without deleting contradicting observations; preserve supersedes/corrects/disputes links.
Feeds and regional packs contain reviewed, public, geographically degraded records only. Private correction text and recipient identities stay out of all public exports.
Manual source-directory HTML pages are not automatically fetchable feeds. Populate RSS/Atom/JSON URLs only after real endpoint verification and configure allowlisted server-side ingestion.
Actor-directory presence does not establish reach, supplies, funding or authority. Never auto-assign a case, spend money, dispatch messages or direct movement.
Outcome verification needs dated follow-up evidence, an independent reviewer where practical, and a stated verification method; a dispatch receipt alone is not a verified welfare outcome.
